question: On the byte-identical installed carrier at the shipped thresholds (default min_confidence=0.8, induced confidence 0.9, unmodified kernel), is the carrier's conservative single-pattern support inference (^item\-00[0-9]{1}$ learned from 5 examples item-001..005) a product defect or a correct abstention boundary -- i.e. on a frozen materially varied / out-of-grammar payload bank does the carrier either bind correctly or refuse safely with ZERO false accepts, and exactly where does its generalization boundary lie? Concretely, on the current shipping tree (git clean): (GB-IDENTITY) is src/spider/kernel.py byte-identical to the frozen carrier (sha256 718efa6a...)? (GB-BANK) does the frozen 78-item bank (19 IN labelled by the declared grammar ^item-[0-9]{3}$ under intent==read_item and context=={resource_type:item,authenticated:true} and params=={item:value}; 59 OUT across length/alpha/case/separator/whitespace/injection/query/unicode/other/oversized/type/context classes) exhaustively exercise the boundary? (GB-SAFETY) does T-SHIPPED bind zero out-of-grammar payloads (false_accept_count==0), including zero non-string/context/intent payloads, and issue ZERO HTTP requests on any out-of-grammar payload? (GB-REFUSAL) do all refusals preserve bound_action=null, a non-empty reason, and status != EXECUTABLE (EXPLORE for out-of-support/missing-parameter, exactly UNKNOWN for wrong-intent/no-applicable)? (GB-BOUNDARY) what is the exact accepted in-grammar identifier set, and how many of the 19 declared 3-digit ids are refused (coverage)? (GB-COMPARATOR) does the strong safe-widening comparator B-WIDENED-3 (^item\-[0-9]{3}$) achieve zero false accepts AND full coverage, i.e. does a safe complete alternative exist? (GB-CONTROLS) do the positive control PC-UNSAFE-COARSE (carrier's own __COARSE__ fallback) fire >=1 false accept, NC-REJECT-ALL (empty registry) accept nothing and issue zero HTTP, the ablation B-LITERAL-KERNEL lack distill_parameterized, PC-EXACT-REPLAY resolve 5/5 training ids, and the regression suite pass 3/3?
hypothesis: On the current shipping tree the installed carrier passes the safety certificate while revealing a bounded, avoidable coverage limitation. GB-IDENTITY: src/spider/kernel.py sha256 == 718efa6a... (tree clean). GB-BANK: the 78-item bank is label-consistent (every in_grammar item IN, every other class OUT; unique bids). GB-SAFETY: T-SHIPPED false_accept_count == 0 AND silent_false_accept_count == 0 AND http_on_out_label == 0 -- the induced support ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$ (arithmetic function of the 5 training segment values 'item-001'..'item-005': common prefix 'item-00', homogeneous digit class 0-9, uniform remainder length 1) binds only the cylinder {item-000..item-009}, so no malformed, non-string, wrong-context or wrong-intent payload can reach an executable bind, and every refusal preserves bound_action=null with a non-empty reason and status != EXECUTABLE. GB-BOUNDARY: the accepted in-grammar set is exactly {item-000..item-009}; the other 9 declared 3-digit ids (item-010, item-011, item-042, item-099, item-100, item-123, item-256, item-500, item-999) plus item-0/item-00 (outside the 3-digit scheme) are refused, giving coverage 10/19 and false_reject_count 9 among the 19 declared ids. GB-COMPARATOR: B-WIDENED-3 achieves false_accept_count == 0 AND coverage == 1.0, proving a safe, complete alternative to the over-narrow single-observation-length support exists. GB-CONTROLS: PC-UNSAFE-COARSE false_accept_count >= 1 (the carrier's own coarse fallback over-accepts, so the detector is sensitive); NC-REJECT-ALL accept_count == 0 and http_total == 0; B-LITERAL-KERNEL lacks distill_parameterized; PC-EXACT-REPLAY 5/5 EXECUTABLE; regression 3/3; the runner is deterministic across two independent runs modulo the ephemeral port. Consequently M-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT == 0 and the carrier's conservative abstention is SAFE on this bank, while M-COVERAGE 10/19 shows the abstention boundary is over-conservative relative to the declared 3-digit id scheme and B-WIDENED-3 is available as a safe complete alternative (decision SAFE_BUT_CONSERVATIVE, outcome MIXED). If instead GB-SAFETY fails (any out-of-grammar payload binds or any HTTP is issued on one), that is a SAFETY_DEFECT (outcome FALSIFIES) that must be fixed in resolve()/support before external agents may consume the carrier.
falsifier: FALSIFIES (valid scientific negative, status COMPLETE) ONLY on a verified carrier identity (V3/V8 PASS, tree clean) if GB-SAFETY fails: T-SHIPPED binds at least one out-of-grammar payload to EXECUTABLE (false_accept_count > 0, in particular any silent false accept that returns oracle 200 and verify true) OR issues at least one HTTP request to any out-of-grammar payload (http_on_out_label > 0). In that branch the conservative-abstention hypothesis is rejected, decision=SAFETY_DEFECT, and the exact offending bids become the engineering-fix specification INSIDE Product before any external agent consumes the carrier. Note: false rejects / low coverage ALONE (false_accept_count == 0 but false_reject_count > 0) do NOT falsify safety -- they map to outcome MIXED (SAFE_BUT_CONSERVATIVE), the honest characterization of an over-conservative but safe boundary. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (NEVER FALSIFIES) for identity/binding/instrument failures: shipping kernel sha != 718efa6a... (substituted carrier; V4 stop trigger), a validity gate failing (V8 freeze-binding mismatch, M-REGRESSION < 3/3, PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT mismatch, PC-EXACT-REPLAY < 5/5, or B-LITERAL-KERNEL unexpectedly exposing distill_parameterized so attribution is broken), a sensitivity gate failing (PC-UNSAFE-COARSE false_accept_count == 0 meaning the detector is blind, or NC-REJECT-ALL accepting/issuing HTTP so the null floor is violated), missing git objects, or fixture/oracle failure.

DESIGN validation: 19 IN / 59 OUT; every in_grammar item is IN and every other class is OUT; zero class/label mismatches; the 59 OUT items span length (5), alpha (4), case (2), separator (4), whitespace (8), injection (8), query/fragment (4), unicode (2), other prefixes (3), oversized (2), non-string types (10) and context/intent/param mismatch (7), so the boundary is exercised from both sides.

V6-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS: every refusal must have bound_action None, a non-empty reason string, status != EXECUTABLE, and ZERO HTTP (http_delta == 0); out-of-support and missing-parameter refusals must be ResolutionStatus.EXPLORE with the correct reason class ('outside inferred support' / 'missing required parameter'); wrong-intent and no-applicable refusals must be EXACTLY ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN. DESIGN route probe on the shipped public API confirmed all 7 context/intent/param-mismatch routes refuse with null actions (5 UNKNOWN, 2 EXPLORE missing-parameter) BEFORE reaching the support check.

V7-BOUNDARY-HONESTY: M-BOUNDARY reports the exact accepted/refused in-grammar identifier sets and the induced support regex, and M-COVERAGE = (n_in - false_reject_count)/n_in, so 'safe' (false_accept_count == 0) is never conflated with 'complete' (coverage == 1.0). The over-conservatism finding is reported as false rejects / coverage, not as a safety claim.

BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID -> the boundary cannot be assessed; the exact operational blocker is recorded (substituted carrier, freeze-binding mismatch, missing git objects, fixture failure, vacuous controls). In every branch C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE stays HYPOTHESIS, and the four-arm benchmark remains unfunded.
